title: Minimum
text: Minimum values of input or sequence of inputs, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Mode}, {Index base} sets the base of the minimum value, {Find the minimum value over} sets the dimension over which the block computes the minimum value Each, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input in running mode Columns, {Rounding mode} sets the method of rounding, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Val
ports.summary: Minimum values along the specified dimension scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Index of the minimum values along the specified dimension scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Mode
params.values: Mode in which the block operates Value and Index (default) | Value | Index | Running

params.name: Index base
params.values: Base of the minimum value index One (default) | Zero

params.name: Find the minimum value over
params.values: Dimension over which the block computes the minimum value Each column (default) | Each row | Entire input | Specified dimension

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input in running mode Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
